content_text: Prediction: the value of all verifiable tasks in the long run is 0. There is no profit there. Anything where the success is defined in a finite and non-ambiguous way, it’s over. Value is 0. The profits are all in taste/judgement related tasks where some like it and some hate it. Vibes only. No rationality. Labs are hillclimbing verifiable tasks now and it might sound impressive that OpenAI found those math proofs but soon others will follow and players like DeepSeek will drive its cost to electricity. Ambiguity is the life line and where the money is. - Anything that’s irrational, vibe driven and controversial with no consensus definition of good is worth something. - If the society all agree on what good looks like for a given task with no ambiguity, it’s worth 0. - caveat: coming up with verifiable task to do is worth a lot because the ability to come up is not a verifiable task by itself
